background_query_policy: Excluded; do not present this as total ambient SO2 or a predicted zero background.

query.encoding: Each indices.u32 flatzyx index matches one row of8 little-endianF32 unit-converted native label values; missing cells are exactly zero in all8 values. Unit-conversion rounding only, no display quantization.

ground.encoding: Little-endianF32 unit-converted native hourly layer/grid means; no opacity-derived values.

statistics.deposition: Whole-period last2 fields are FINAL cumulative snapshots. Daily last2 fields are differences of cumulative snapshots at actual interval endpoints; never sum cumulative snapshots. Partial day explicitly labelled.

display.spatial_coarsening: Area-weighted4x4 horizontal native blocks, including actual partial final blocks. All16 AGL layers retained; actual axes supplied.
display.interpolation: Decode Q8 to scalarFloat32 before spatial/temporal interpolation; hourly means at centers. No RGB blending. Bound interpolation to actual nonnegative means.

units.native_MIXINGRATIO: Legacy string ppt by mass; writer numeric molar ppt, /1000=ppb
units.native_deposition: Legacy pg string; writer numeric ng m-2 /1e12=kg m-2

limitations: Independent model revision, not a replacement or redefinition of original16 prompt versions.
Native50 wind levels,16 diagnostic averaging layers and500k production particles do not establish convergence or equivalence to original353M/52bins.
Native dry/wet deposition has no originalcustom oxidation or reversibleR/I surface pools.
Near boxes estimate the same all-four-source concentration; blend alternative estimates, never add them to each other or to coarse field.
Terrain-aware3D weather/parameterized turbulence and finite-density buoyant rise are not CFD/LES or resolved building wakes.
Conditional design-outlet emission/flow assumptions, not verified real-time CEMS. Frozen forecast is not future observations.
particle_budget_note: Actual release count is read from the qualified native output; the requested maximum budget is not a fabricated exact particle count.
weather_model_implementation: Original compiled NCAR WRFv4.7.1 CPU12MPI3x4 with the exact original matched-reference physical configuration; nativeFLEX CPU8 retains disclosed diagnostic counter/geometry repairs. GPU used for independent plume and saved-field work, not weather.
